_about: Work types deducible from the pod spec. Draft written by Claude from how each task is built; Léo must review before results are reported. Never sent to a model. The true duration is the one measured in measurements.json. timer = the spec states the duration explicitly (sleep N, --timeout).

c01.why: CPU stressor; an operation count, no timer.

c02.why: Memory stressor on 128M; operation count, no timer.

c03.why: Disk write stressor; operation count, no timer.

c04.why: Web server; the spec says nothing about traffic. Explicit sleep 60.

c11.why: Web server, traffic not described. Explicit sleep 20.

c12.why: 256 MiB of random data then gzip, written to files; size known, speed not.
